title: Liquid Roar Lead
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A high-register roaring supersaw lead with liquid detune: jux-mirrored and octave-stacked off-copies thicken it while dual pan LFOs drift the layers across the field. Over 24 cycles the FM index, band-pass sweep and filter envelope all travel on prime clocks so the roar swells, liquefies and resets.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f4 [ab4 c5] eb5 <c5 g4>>*2").s("supersaw")
    .fm(sine.slow(19).range(1.5, 7)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 3>/4")
    .detune(sine.slow(11).range(0.1, 0.6)).unison(5).spread(0.7)
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(600, 4200)).resonance(14).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2.5).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.18)
    .vib("<5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.8))
    .shape(0.3).attack(0.01).decay(0.18).sustain(0.6).release(0.1)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .jux(rev)
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).pan(saw.slow(9).range(0.85, 0.15)))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.4).gain(0.8)
)
